title: 法巴Grace Tam：通胀压力未加剧，美联储转向或早于预期？
speaker: Grace Tam

segments.en: I mean, are you expecting that peak and hawkishness to be earlier next year or later? We hope that especially in terms of inflation numbers, if you look at the PCE, it's still high, of course, it's still well above the inflation target of the fed.
segments.zh: 你预计峰值和鹰派立场会在明年更早还是更晚出现？我们希望，尤其是通胀数据，看看PCE，它仍然很高，当然仍远高于美联储的通胀目标。

segments.en: But at least it's not intensifying. So as long as the inflation is not, I mean, continued to escalate or maybe have chance
segments.zh: 但至少没有加剧。所以只要通胀没有持续升级，或者可能有机会

segments.en: because as you see, energy prices or prices actually got some declines, quite sharp declines
segments.zh: 因为如你所见，能源价格或价格实际上最近出现了一些下降，相当急剧的下降

segments.en: recently. And for now, everybody expect the AI growth is going to slow down, right?
segments.zh: 目前，大家都预期AI增长将放缓，对吧？

segments.en: And that also could, I mean, help in terms of inflationary pressure.
segments.zh: 这也可能有助于缓解通胀压力。

segments.en: So this whole set up actually could maybe be able to see some slow down in terms of inflation next year.
segments.zh: 所以整个格局实际上可能明年会看到通胀有所放缓。
